goal: Fixes a stall where IBD sync can get permanently stuck behind an addnode or inbound peer that returns empty headers
Closes issue #34096 so nodes relying on manual/inbound peers no longer freeze during initial headers sync
reviewability: Ready to review now, CI passes and no rebase is needed
Open threads are a minor test-necessity question and a documentation request, neither blocks review
agreement: Concept ACK without detailed reasons (jeanpablojp, hodlinator)
Unaddressed objection: a peer can still bypass the backoff and reacquire the slot repeatedly (danielabrozzoni)
Drawback acknowledged but deferred as follow-up rather than fixed now (l0rinc)
Nonblocking objection: PR description should disclose the residual attack risk (hodlinator)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a real IBD-stalling bug affecting addnode and inbound peer users
Reproduced locally by the author and confirmed on mainnet by another user, so the benefit is concrete
Only a partial fix since a related reacquisition attack remains unresolved, capping its impact below P1
